_what: The certificate authority that lets this computer's capture proxy read the secure traffic of programs the person points at it (computer/capture-ca.mjs). It is made on this computer, once, and is never shared: the private key stays in a 0600 file under `folder`. It expires after `ca_days` and is made again when fewer than `renew_days` remain; the leaf certificate for each site is short-lived (`leaf_days`). Programs trust it only if the person trusts it (`trust.argv`); nothing here trusts it by itself.

words.made: Made this computer's capture certificate authority; it expires {expires}.
words.kept: The capture certificate authority is in force until {expires}.
words.renewed: The capture certificate authority was about to expire and was made again; trust it again to keep capturing.
words.bad_host: {host} is not a host name or address a certificate can be made for.
words.openssl_failed: The certificate could not be made: {error}
